agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: Who is on the team and what each one may do. The conversation belongs to the Assistant; what they may touch in the field is a mission.
agents.newAgentNote: Created as draft with no tools: an agent that declares nothing cannot act, and the catalogue says so until you give it a contract.
agents.field.name: Name
agents.edit.identityHint: The name is what the operator types after @; the class decides which lane it works in.
agents.edit.class.orchestrator: Plans and delegates; answers the operator.
agents.edit.class.analyst: Answers about the estate with the read tools.
agents.edit.class.query: Reads one record and returns it.
agents.edit.class.field: Runs a typed task inside a mission's envelope.
agents.edit.status.draft: Declared but not trusted yet: it cannot be dispatched.
agents.edit.status.active: Available to the orchestrator and to missions.
agents.edit.status.archived: Kept for the record; never chosen again.
agents.edit.descriptionHint: What it does and what it is for.
agents.edit.toolsHint: Only these tools are offered to the model. One that does not exist is reported, never hidden.

agents.edit.toolsMissing.other: {n} declared tools do not exist yet
agents.edit.mustReturnHint: The fields the result must carry. An answer missing one is incomplete, not a success.
